baslik: How Does a Wind Turbine Work? A Piece-by-Piece 3D Teardown | NREL 5 MW
aciklama:
We take a wind turbine apart piece by piece: the power in the wind and the power curve, the blade layers (glass fibre, carbon spar caps, balsa core), inside the nacelle (main shaft, 97:1 gearbox, brake, generator, converter), moving giant blades, crane erection, the path of electricity to the grid and pitch/yaw storm protection.
Model: NREL 5 MW reference turbine (126 m rotor, 90 m hub, 11.4 m/s rated wind, 6.9–12.1 rpm rotor).

00:47 The blade
